script.text: SpaceX just reported 14.6 billion dollars in sales. What is it actually selling?

After the close on Tuesday, SpaceX reported third-quarter revenue up 161 percent, to 14.6 billion dollars. Analysts polled by LSEG expected about 12.7 billion. Net income was 4.4 billion dollars, after a loss of 541 million last quarter.

The biggest piece was not Starlink. The AI unit, now called Super Intelligence, brought in 7.56 billion dollars, about 52 percent of sales. Starlink's connectivity business earned 5.25 billion, above analyst forecasts.

SpaceX shares closed at 147.79 dollars on Tuesday. CNBC reports they rose about 10 percent in premarket trading Wednesday. On the call, Elon Musk called a merger with Tesla a good idea. Both boards have formed special committees to discuss it.
Will SpaceX and Tesla really merge? Yes or no?
